Subject: Discovery recap + pilot options

Hi Mira —

Thanks again for taking time on Friday to walk through BrightLane's inference workload and the telemetry you shared. Quick recap of what we heard and two small pilot paths so you can pick the one that fits your timeline: 

What we heard
- Primary need: consistent <200 ms latency for short clinical-text prompts and patient-facing responses.
- Constraints: SOC 2 + controlled VPC, and peak concurrency around 60 req/s during morning windows.
- Success metrics: <200ms p95, <0.02 USD/token unit cost target for baseline queries, and no PHI leaving customer VPC during evaluation.

Pilot options
1) Short latency validation (2 weeks) — we run a small private deployment in our demo VPC with your sample prompts (no PHI). Outcome: p95 latency and throughput report + optimization recipe.
2) Scoped private trial (6 weeks) — VPC deployment with customer-managed keys + traffic routing from a small internal app. Outcome: integration checklist + rollback playbook and cost estimate for steady-state.

Next steps (proposed)
- If short latency validation: I can spin up the env and run the first report by Jul 12.
- If scoped trial: we'll need procurement loop and a brief security questionnaire — estimate 2–3 weeks to start.

I've attached the brief demo deck and the recording from our session. Would you have 15 minutes this week to pick option 1 vs 2? If now isn't right, a one-line reply saying when to check back is totally fine.

Attachments: BrightLane-demo-deck.pdf (6 slides) — discovery-recording.mp4 (25m)

Best,
Diego
